original.target_description: Overall identity-achievement dimension correlated with overall conscientiousness (continuous scores), p. 237 / PDF p. 11.

n.sample_role: Participants; 198 is the retained study sample, not an explicitly reported analytic N for this correlation.
n.exclusions: Ten other participants excluded for failing the NEO-PI validity check. Table 1 additionally documents missing data; pairwise missingness for the target dimensional correlation is not specified.
n.location: pp. 232–233, Method—Subjects; p. 235, Table 1 note; p. 237, Dimensional Results—conscientiousness
n.quote:
The sample consisted of 198 undergraduate psychology students at a
large midwestern university. ... Ten other subjects who failed a validity check on the NEO-PI
were excluded. ... Cell sizes varied due to missing data. ... Conscientiousness, in contrast, was
inversely related to moratorium and diffusion identity dimensions but
positively related to the achievement identity dimension, rs = —.22,
— .38, p < .001, and r = 30, p < .001, respectively.

notes: Only assigned unfinished field n_o was examined for completion; all unassigned statistic fields and replication/success records are placeholders. Target paragraph prints r = .30, p < .001 (canonical OCR renders r = 30); PDF layout checked. These unassigned statistics are retained only as target-location context.
